boundary_invariant_form.note: Nonzero multiples are z * [[0,1],[1,0]], z real. The zero form is the degenerate solution.

clifford_does_not_choose_signature.note: The Clifford relation is not a positivity source.

spring_completion_matches_signed_term.note: Prime spring energy stays nonnegative. After the counterterm removes 2 a ||F||^2, the leftover is -2 a <F, TF>, signed with the autocorrelation.

fq_inertia_not_determinant.note: Negative semidefinite tracks the Hasse inequality. det > 0 is not positivity. Discrete samples are not Mellin moments; this check does not identify them.

trace_norm_nonnegative_signed_remainder_.note: A trace-norm leakage cannot be given a negative sign. Report the nonnegative norm and, separately, any signed quadratic remainder. The draft S={infinity,2} leakage test was not run.

bps_toy_hessian.note: Toy of the architecture only. Not an arithmetic instanton, and not a sign for W.

completed_zeta_ratio_is_one.note: Meromorphic consequence of Λ(s) = Λ(1-s). No group-delay positivity. The local archimedean phase delay is a different function, K.

virasoro_h_minus_one_is_algebra.note: Null at c=26. This is not a unitarity proof. c here is the Virasoro central charge, not a speed and not a topological charge.
